answer.reason: The verses tell what was done with the tower and what happened to it and its builders.

clauses.english: was built with the city by men hoping to reach heaven and make a name
clauses.quote: let us build us a city and a tower, whose top may reach unto heaven

clauses.english: was left unfinished when the LORD confounded the language of the builders and scattered them
clauses.quote: the LORD scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth

doubts: The tower is not named separately in GEN 11:8-9; the city's name Babel is used there, so the second clause rests on the building left off.
